data.name: Iron Skin
data.description: The ironskin monk gains a +%1 bonus to his natural armor. This bonus stacks with any existing natural armor the ironskin monk already has. At 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1. This ability replaces the monk's AC bonus ability and the ability to add his Wisdom bonus to his AC.|IronskinMonkIronSkinBonus
